actions.action: Check soil moisture 2-3 inches down before watering
Slide plant out of pot and inspect roots
Trim mushy/rotten roots with clean scissors if present
Repot into pot 1-2 inches wider than root ball with chunky mix (soil, orchid bark, perlite) and drainage holes
Optionally trim brown parts of damaged leaves
Occasionally flush soil with water to wash out salts
If roots are fine, water more evenly
If roots are fine, add humidifier or pebble tray
Reply with watering frequency, drainage and root condition

reason: The answer's top cause is overwatering in an oversized pot, and its main advice (water only when dry, repot into a pot 1-2 inches wider) matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
